title.zh: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models

note.en: Shows that fine-tuning on many datasets phrased as instructions improves a model's generalisation to unseen tasks.
note.zh: 证明在大量以指令形式表述的数据集上微调，可提升模型对未见任务的泛化能力。

title.en: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning
title.zh: A Review of Sparse Expert Models in Deep Learning

note.en: A survey of sparse expert models — Mixture-of-Experts, Switch Transformers and their relatives — written with Barret Zoph and William Fedus.
note.zh: 与 Barret Zoph、William Fedus 合著，综述稀疏专家模型——混合专家、Switch Transformer 及其相关架构。

title.en: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
title.zh: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models

note.en: Documents abilities that appear abruptly at scale rather than improving smoothly, a framing that shaped years of scaling debate.
note.zh: 记录了随规模突然涌现、而非平滑提升的能力，这一提法影响了此后多年关于规模化的讨论。

title.en: An Evolutionary Approach to Dynamic Introduction of Tasks in Large-scale Multitask Learning Systems
title.zh: An Evolutionary Approach to Dynamic Introduction of Tasks in Large-scale Multitask Learning Systems

note.en: An evolutionary method for adding new tasks to a large multitask system without retraining it from scratch.
note.zh: 一种演化方法，可向大型多任务系统中动态加入新任务而无需从头重训。

title.en: muNet: Evolving Pretrained Deep Neural Networks into Scalable Auto-tuning Multitask Systems
title.zh: muNet: Evolving Pretrained Deep Neural Networks into Scalable Auto-tuning Multitask Systems

note.en: Turns pretrained networks into self-tuning multitask systems that grow by reusing existing parameters rather than training anew.
note.zh: 将预训练网络转化为可自调优的多任务系统，通过复用已有参数扩展而非重新训练。

title.en: The Carbon Footprint of Machine Learning Training Will Plateau, Then Shrink
title.zh: The Carbon Footprint of Machine Learning Training Will Plateau, Then Shrink

note.en: Argues with David Patterson that four practices can cut ML training energy up to 100x, an early statement of his position on AI's climate cost.
note.zh: 与 David Patterson 合著，指出四项做法可将机器学习训练能耗最多降低百倍，是他关于 AI 气候成本立场的早期表述。

title.en: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
title.zh: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

note.en: PaLM, the 540-billion-parameter model trained on Pathways, and the paper that demonstrated that system at full scale.
note.zh: PaLM 是基于 Pathways 训练的 5400 亿参数模型，该论文展示了这套系统的全规模运行能力。

title.en: Pathways: Asynchronous Distributed Dataflow for ML
title.zh: Pathways: Asynchronous Distributed Dataflow for ML

note.en: The orchestration layer he co-designed for running ML workloads asynchronously across thousands of accelerators.
note.zh: 他参与设计的编排层，用于在数千个加速器上异步运行机器学习负载。

title.en: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models
title.zh: ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models

note.en: Makes sparse expert models stable enough to train reliably and transferable to downstream tasks.
note.zh: 使稀疏专家模型的训练足够稳定可靠，并能迁移到下游任务。

title.en: Google AI with Jeff Dean
title.zh: Google AI with Jeff Dean

note.en: Old (2018) Google Cloud Platform Podcast episode where Dean, then head of Google AI, discussed AI/ML research and his outreach work at Deep Learning Indaba.
note.zh: 2018年Google Cloud Platform播客节目，时任Google AI负责人的Jeff Dean探讨了AI与机器学习研究，以及他在Deep Learning Indaba的推广工作。

title.en: Systems and Software for Machine Learning at Scale with Jeff Dean - TWiML Talk #124
title.zh: Systems and Software for Machine Learning at Scale with Jeff Dean - TWiML Talk #124

posts.source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…

note.en: An early TWiML interview, recorded at Google, on the systems and software built to train machine learning at scale.
note.zh: 早期 TWiML 访谈，在谷歌录制，谈为大规模机器学习训练所构建的系统与软件。

title.en: Leaves Google after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop
title.zh: 离开 Google（27 年）联合创立 Discovery Loop

body.en: A public benefit corporation aimed at automating scientific and engineering research, starting with ML research and engineering itself, then hardware design, drug discovery and clean energy. Co-founders: Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, Quoc Le. Google is a founding investor and cloud partner; Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures co-lead the seed. Last day at Google: 6 Aug 2026.
body.zh: 一家公益公司，目标是自动化科学与工程研究：先做 ML 研究与工程本身，再拓展到硬件设计、药物发现与清洁能源。联合创始人：Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le。Google 为创始投资人兼云伙伴，Radical Ventures 与 Khosla Ventures 联合领投种子轮。8 月 6 日为其在 Google 的最后一天。

title.en: Ex-Googler Jeff Dean Explains Design Choices Behind Gemini
title.zh: Ex-Googler Jeff Dean Explains Design Choices Behind Gemini

body.en: In a post-Google interview, Jeff Dean detailed the design choices behind Gemini.
body.zh: 离开谷歌后，Jeff Dean在采访中详细讲述了Gemini背后的设计决策。

title.en: Ex-Google chief scientist Jeff Dean targets $50B valuation for new AI startup Discovery Loop
title.zh: Ex-Google chief scientist Jeff Dean targets $50B valuation for new AI startup Discovery Loop

body.en: Dean's new startup Discovery Loop is reportedly targeting a $50B valuation, months after he left Google.
body.zh: 据报道，迪恩离开谷歌后创立的新公司Discovery Loop正寻求500亿美元估值。

title.en: Former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean is raising again for his new AI startup, seeking around a $50 billion valuation
title.zh: Former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean is raising again for his new AI startup, seeking around a $50 billion valuation

body.en: Dean is reportedly raising a new funding round for his startup Discovery Loop at around a $50 billion valuation.
body.zh: 据报道，Dean正在为其新公司Discovery Loop筹集新一轮融资，估值约500亿美元。

title.en: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a small AI startup
title.zh: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a small AI startup

body.en: Jeff Dean explained why he left Google after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop, a small AI startup — confirming the departure that also ended his authorship of Google's research blog.
body.zh: Jeff Dean讲述了他为何在谷歌工作27年后离职，联合创立小型AI初创公司Discovery Loop——这也意味着他不再是谷歌研究博客的作者。

title.en: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a 4-person AI startup
title.zh: Why Jeff Dean says he left Google after 27 years to build a 4-person AI startup

body.en: Jeff Dean explained why he left Google after 27 years to found a four-person AI startup focused on automating machine-learning research.
body.zh: Jeff Dean解释了他在谷歌工作27年后离职、创办一家仅有四人的AI初创公司、专注于将机器学习研究本身自动化的原因。

title.en: Jeff Dean's First Post-Google Act: Automating the Scientific Method
title.zh: Jeff Dean's First Post-Google Act: Automating the Scientific Method

body.en: A profile of Discovery Loop, the company he founded after 27 years at Google, whose purpose is to automate the scientific method itself.
body.zh: 关于 Discovery Loop 的报道——这是他在谷歌工作 27 年后创办的公司，目标是让科学研究方法本身实现自动化。

title.en: Jeff Dean and top Google researchers quit Alphabet to launch Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures
title.zh: Jeff Dean and top Google researchers quit Alphabet to launch Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures

body.en: He leaves Alphabet with a group of senior Google researchers to found Discovery Loop, backed by Radical Ventures.
body.zh: 他带着一批谷歌资深研究员离开 Alphabet，创办由 Radical Ventures 支持的 Discovery Loop。

title.en: Ex-Google AI legend Jeff Dean raises $1B seed for Discovery Loop at $10B valuation
title.zh: Ex-Google AI legend Jeff Dean raises $1B seed for Discovery Loop at $10B valuation

body.en: Discovery Loop raises a reported $1B seed round at a $10B valuation, one of the largest seed rounds on record.
body.zh: Discovery Loop 据报以 100 亿美元估值完成 10 亿美元种子轮，是有记录以来最大的种子轮之一。

title.en: Departing Google chief scientist Jeff Dean has been in talks for a $10 billion valuation for his new AI startup
title.zh: Departing Google chief scientist Jeff Dean has been in talks for a $10 billion valuation for his new AI startup

body.en: Reports Dean, who departed Google, is in talks to value his new AI startup at $10 billion.
body.zh: 报道离开谷歌后的Jeff Dean，正就其新AI初创公司100亿美元估值进行融资谈判。

title.en: Jeff Dean's 1% Rule: Build Where Frontier Models Fail
title.zh: Jeff Dean's 1% Rule: Build Where Frontier Models Fail

body.en: Dealroom profile on Dean's investment thesis for his new venture: build products where frontier models still fail.
body.zh: Dealroom报道Jeff Dean为新公司提出的投资理念：专注于前沿大模型仍然表现不佳的领域。

title.en: Jeff Dean Turning In His Google Badge & Google Laptop
title.zh: Jeff Dean Turning In His Google Badge & Google Laptop

body.en: Jeff Dean left Google after 27 years, turning in his badge and laptop, to build Discovery Loop.
body.zh: 在谷歌工作27年后，Jeff Dean离职，交还工牌和笔记本电脑，转而创办Discovery Loop。

title.en: Loss of ‘most Google’ engineer Jeff Dean jolts morale inside the company’s AI ranks
title.zh: Loss of ‘most Google’ engineer Jeff Dean jolts morale inside the company’s AI ranks

body.en: The Los Angeles Times reported that Dean's departure from Google has shaken morale inside the company's AI teams, confirming his exit after 27 years.
body.zh: 《洛杉矶时报》报道称，Dean离开谷歌一事动摇了公司AI团队的士气，证实了他在效力27年后的离职。

title.en: Google Brain Co-Founder Jeff Dean Launches AI Startup
title.zh: Google Brain Co-Founder Jeff Dean Launches AI Startup

body.en: Jeff Dean, who spent 27 years at Google including co-founding Google Brain, has launched a new AI startup.
body.zh: 在Google工作27年、联合创立Google Brain的Jeff Dean已创立一家新的AI创业公司。

title.en: Google loses Jeff Dean, sidelines Hassabis from operations in biggest AI shake-up since 2023
title.zh: Google loses Jeff Dean, sidelines Hassabis from operations in biggest AI shake-up since 2023

body.en: Reports confirmed Dean's departure from Google after 27 years, described as the company's biggest leadership shake-up since 2023, alongside Hassabis stepping back from operations.
body.zh: 报道证实迪恩在效力谷歌27年后离职，这被称为谷歌自2023年以来最大的一次领导层变动，哈萨比斯同时也从运营岗位上退了下来。

title.en: AI Pioneers Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat Launch Discovery Loop to Accelerate Scientific Research
title.zh: AI Pioneers Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat Launch Discovery Loop to Accelerate Scientific Research

body.en: Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat launched Discovery Loop, a new company aimed at automating scientific and machine-learning research, following Dean's departure from Google.
body.zh: Jeff Dean离开谷歌后，与Sanjay Ghemawat共同创立了Discovery Loop，致力于将科学与机器学习研究自动化。

title.en: Google shakes up AI leadership. Demis Hassabis takes on broader research role, and Jeff Dean leaves.
title.zh: Google shakes up AI leadership. Demis Hassabis takes on broader research role, and Jeff Dean leaves.

body.en: Google restructured its AI leadership: Demis Hassabis took on a broader research role while Jeff Dean departed the company after 27 years, going on to co-found Discovery Loop.
body.zh: 谷歌调整AI领导层：Demis Hassabis接掌更广泛的研究职责，而Jeff Dean在任职27年后离开公司，随后联合创立Discovery Loop。

title.en: Google Eyes $1.5B Investment In AI Coding Startup As AI Brain Drain Continues With Jeff Dean's Exit
title.zh: Google Eyes $1.5B Investment In AI Coding Startup As AI Brain Drain Continues With Jeff Dean's Exit

body.en: Coverage of Jeff Dean's departure from Google after 27 years, amid reports Google is weighing a $1.5B investment in an AI coding startup.
body.zh: 报道杰夫·迪恩在谷歌工作27年后离职，同时谷歌据传正考虑向一家AI编程初创公司投资15亿美元。

title.en: Jeff Dean Leaves Google to Launch Discovery Loop AI Research Startup - Межа. Новини України.
title.zh: Jeff Dean Leaves Google to Launch Discovery Loop AI Research Startup - Межа. Новини України.

body.en: Jeff Dean left Google after 27 years to launch Discovery Loop, an AI research startup built to automate machine-learning research itself.
body.zh: 杰夫·迪恩在谷歌工作27年后离职，创立了Discovery Loop，一家致力于将机器学习研究本身自动化的AI初创公司。
